description: Camera model fitted to Helsinki GT box-centre displacements (218 consecutive-frame pairs, mean residual 0.75 px). Ground plane Z=0, camera at height h looking down; cam = rot_y(roll) @ rot_x(pitch) @ diag(1,1,h) applied to ground (X,Y,1); image = K @ cam with K = [[f,0,cx],[0,f,cy],[0,0,1]]. Camera translates by (tx,ty) metres per frame, so the ground appears to move by (-tx,-ty). Per-frame image map A = G @ T @ inv(G) with T = translation(-tx,-ty).
notes: affine row i: new_coord_i = a*x + b*y + c (source px). Centre (1920,1080) moves ~(0.0, +66.2) px/frame; flow ~51 px/frame at the top edge and ~80 px/frame at the bottom edge; objects appear ~30% larger at the bottom than at the top.
